_comment: Concept blocks (OR-ed terms) and queries (AND-ed groups of blocks). Rendered per source by scripts/querybuild.py. Every executed version is recorded in raw/run_log.jsonl and summarised in query_log.md; when a block or query changes, bump the version of every affected query.

queries._changelog: | v2: restricted to visualization/HCI/XR venues (DBLP venue list; EGDL; ACM/IEEE with publication filter) because the unrestricted OpenAlex run (v1) returned 966 hits, mostly AR applications outside visualization (random sample of 12)

_dblp_note: DBLP is searched on titles only, restricted to visualization/HCI/VR venues; the VIS group is therefore dropped and single-word stems are used (dblp_groups).
_egdl_note: EGDL (DSpace/Solr) phrase queries on dc.description.abstract returned almost nothing (2 hits for "multilayer network" vs 25 for multilayer AND network), so multi-word terms are rendered as AND of their words within the same field.
